component.name: Observatory Core
component.summary: Elite Dangerous journal monitoring and exploration assistance

description.p: A native Rust desktop application for monitoring Elite Dangerous journals on Linux. Explorer identifies interesting scans, Botanist tracks biological sampling, and Communicator displays sent and received messages.
Includes native BioInsights, Evaluator, Hecate and StellarOverlay workers, journal replay, persistent findings, CSV export and Lua extensions.
